lines.platformer.say.start: The dead will not rest tonight. I must reach the gate.
lines.platformer.say.clear: The gate is open. Whatever waits inside, I am ready.

notes.platformer.vale: The hero's name, over his lines in the dialog box.
notes.platformer.say.start: Vale, to himself, as the stage begins.
notes.platformer.say.clear: Vale, to himself, at the castle gate: the end of the stage.
notes.platformer.say.score: The points this time and the most ever, after the stage; spaces as shown.
notes.platformer.stage: The stage's name, shown large as it begins.
notes.platformer.hint.jump: What the jump button does, after its key on the controls ribbon ("Space jump"): lower case, short.
notes.platformer.hint.slash: What the attack button does, after its key ("X slash"): lower case, short.
notes.platformer.hint.dash: What the dash button does, after its key ("Shift dash"): lower case, short.
notes.platformer.hint.view: The V key turns the camera to a 2.5D view (a 3D look on the 2D level): keep V and 2.5D.
notes.platformer.hint.moves: The sword's special moves, four hints separated by a dot: up + attack rises, down + attack in the air dives, dash + attack thrusts, holding attack spins. Keep the arrows and the {key:...} tags.

brief: The platformer slice: a side-scrolling action platformer in the manner of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, gothic and grave. Vale, a swordsman (a man), fights skeletons, bats and armored knights across a graveyard to a castle's gate; he speaks only to himself, briefly and solemnly. The hints on the ribbon at the bottom are short and lower case.
